In this episode, I show you how I built a full professional website in just a few minutes using Readdy.ai. I walk through how I used it to copy and customize a site from another industry and turn it into a luxury home service website for my new business, Backyard Funhouse. I test everything from swapping out images and adding promo timers to setting up AI-powered voice and chat agents that automatically book appointments and respond to leads. Toward the end, I break down how you can use this same tool to start your own website-building agency and even charge clients based on the value you create, not just your time.
